content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) provides a basic digital commerce stack with automatic crypto payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. It includes a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 file delivery, and NOWPayments payment processing. EDGE Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more advanced digital commerce stack with end-to-end testing, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and 24/7 support. It includes all the features of the Sovereign Starter Stack plus more advanced security features and a dedicated support team. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides a comprehensive guide to building a sovereign digital commerce stack, including the source code, NOWPayments integration guide, and scaling playbook. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, providing everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Sovereign digital commerce stacks are not subject to the same platform restrictions as traditional payment gateways. This means that digital sellers in restricted countries can collect payment without being locked out by their platform of choice. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators have full control over their infrastructure and data, and can choose from a variety of payment gateways and processors to suit their needs.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, traditional platforms can be expensive and time-consuming. Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can add up quickly for digital sellers. In contrast, NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it a more cost-effective option for creators. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference would retain $921, a significant amount of money that could be invested back into the business.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks provide full control and ownership over payment processing, delivery, and customer data.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators have full control over their infrastructure and data. This means that they can automate delivery of their products, track customer orders, and manage their inventory without relying on a third-party platform. With NOWPayments, payment processing is automated, and customers can pay with their preferred cryptocurrency, making the checkout process faster and more convenient for both the creator and the customer.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of digital commerce architecture depends on the specific needs and goals of the creator. The Sovereign Starter Stack is a basic, cost-effective option for small businesses or solo creators. The EDGE Commerce Stack is a more advanced option for larger businesses or those with complex payment requirements. The Sovereign Blueprint and Complete Builder Kit provide a comprehensive guide to building a sovereign digital commerce stack, and are ideal for creators who want to customize their infrastructure and data ownership.

Your Deployment Checklist

To build a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up a backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, select an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, set up file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments. Deploy your stack and test it thoroughly, then configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC and set up 24/7 support. Finally, monitor your sales and customer orders, and adjust your infrastructure as needed to optimize performance and profitability.
